name: primeval_bounty_two_lands_at_once_gain_twice
notes: M6 mapper. Printed: 'Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, put three +1/+1 counters on target creature you control. Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, you gain 3 life.' Support card: FDN Grow from the Ashes (mapped; kicked: 'search your library for two basic land cards, put them onto the battlefield'). Seat 0 casts it kicked: a noncreature spell, so the cast trigger puts three +1/+1 counters on seat 0's Bear (its one legal target). The library holds just the two basics, so the search takes both; the one decision orders the two landfall triggers. The Forest and the Island enter at the same time: each is a land entering, so landfall triggers twice (once per land, not once for the event) and seat 0 gains 6.
